description: Ranks NetActuate data centers by great-circle distance from a place named in the question: the market to be served, where the end users are, or a city being compared. Use for 'what is your closest location to Lagos', 'which sites would serve users in Japan' or latency planning. Pass the place the question is about, not where the person asking is, unless they ask for the site nearest them and say where that is. Each result is a site summary with distanceKm, nearest first. Distances are computed from city centroids, so treat them as approximate guidance, not a latency guarantee. Places are matched against a built-in list of major cities and countries; one it does not know is reported, and latitude and longitude can be passed instead.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, with longitude, when the place name is not recognised.

limit.description: How many sites to return, 1 to 20.

location.description: The place to measure from: the target market or the end users' city or country, e.g. 'Lagos', 'Berlin', 'Osaka, Japan'. Omit if passing coordinates.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, with latitude, when the place name is not recognised.

name: find_nearest_data_centers
title: Find the nearest NetActuate PoPs
